findings.title: Vulnerable dependency mathjs@3.10.1
findings.message: mathjs@3.10.1 is affected by GHSA-pv8x-p9hq-j328 (Arbitrary Code Execution in mathjs).
findings.remediation: Upgrade mathjs to 3.17.0 or later (data from OSV).

fix.diff:
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
# bump mathjs from 3.10.1 to 3.17.0

findings.title: Vulnerable dependency node-serialize@0.0.4

findings.title: SQL injection via string concatenation
findings.message: Tainted input is concatenated into a SQL string passed to query/execute.
findings.remediation: SQL injection via string concatenation. See https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/89.html
